list: The official 55 trophies, frozen 2026-11-18 (Exophase + PSNProfiles agree on every name, description and grade). Rockstar has NOT published its own list; 'official' here means the PSN-published list as frozen by Exophase and PSNProfiles.
psnCountsAsOf: 2026-11-19 (Exophase, % of PSN players who earned each trophy)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The last trophy you will earn. It pops the moment the other 54 are done, so treat it as the finish line, not a task: follow the roadmap, clear the story, then work the 100% checklist. Nothing about it can be missed — it simply waits for everything else.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed — play through the opening and the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story only — keep playing and the trophy pops at the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Story only — it pops at the chapter's final mission, so just keep playing through the story.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Story only — it pops at the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Story only — it pops at the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. It pops when the mission ends and the credits roll — no extra objective is needed, just complete the story.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It pops when the mission ends — story only, nothing to prepare.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It pops when the mission ends — story only, nothing to prepare.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It pops when the mission ends — story only, nothing to prepare.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It pops when the mission ends — story only, nothing to prepare.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It pops when the mission ends — story only, nothing to prepare.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops when the mission ends — story only, nothing to prepare.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% Completion. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist — earlier progress counts toward it, so nothing is wasted. The checklist is roughly 60% of everything the game tracks: about 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 8 vaults and 39 illegal operations. Work through it after the credits; nothing on it is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, and there are 397 stunts in total, so you have room to pick the easy ones. The in-game counter tracks your total, and 300 stunts are needed for 100% completion — keep going past this trophy.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are nine activity types; sampling one of each is enough — you do not need to win or master any of them. Open the activities list and work through it one by one, ticking each type off as you try it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 challenges at the two shooting ranges. Gold needs accuracy and speed, so learn one range's layout first, then repeat it. Use a weapon you control well, and restart a challenge the moment a run goes bad instead of finishing it.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for the trophy — 42 wins are needed for 100% completion. Learn each course's corners on a practice run first, then race for the win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — road, off-road, boat or air — so pick the short ones and the vehicle classes you drive best. Replays of the same race do not count twice, so keep moving to races you have not won yet.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the spot with a purple icon — go there and take the challenge. Lighter tackle and steady reeling beat brute force; do not yank the line when the fish runs.
sources: PowerPyx via OutputLag — Cal's text and marker

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk into any arcade, start any game, and play it through to its end. It does not need a high score — finishing is what counts.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's strand of missions to its last one and the trophy pops at its end. Andy's strand is one of the stranger strands, so look for his marker on the map between story missions.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's strand of missions to its last one and the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand of missions to its last one and the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count toward the eight; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not, because they have their own trophies. Check the in-game progress counter after each strand so you know where you stand. Yago's race in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive — it carries an hourglass icon — so save first.
sources: PowerPyx via OutputLag — who counts, Yago's hourglass

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand of missions to its last one and the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's strand of missions to its last one and the trophy pops at its end.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 spots in 10 locations, for Jason and Lucia; an outdoor spot counts twice if both of them meditate there. THE missable one: Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation — after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia goes to the balcony of Jason's house in the morning — disappears after Chapter 1, so do it before the chapter ends and keep a Chapter 1 save. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18 spots, but this trophy needs every spot.
sources: PowerPyx via OutputLag — 18 spots, balcony missable

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and opens after Chapter 2. UNCONFIRMED: the exact animal has not been pinned down yet — no guide has confirmed it — so follow Bret's questline and take the hunt he offers. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. Do not trust any named animal until a source confirms it.
sources: PowerPyx via OutputLag — Bret questline, animal unconfirmed

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida; a set completes when you hold every card in it. Track sets in the collection menu and sweep one region at a time so you do not re-check the same streets twice.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app and scan a landmark, view or point of interest; each new location counts once. It pairs naturally with exploring the map for The Goodtime State — scan as you travel instead of making a separate trip.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges cover driving, shooting, flying and more; the counter in the pause menu shows your total. Pick the quick ones first — many complete in a single short attempt — and the total builds up while you chase other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape. Easiest during a bank vault escape: rob a vault with your partner, build four stars on the way out, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. The same run also counts toward Maximum Withdrawal.
sources: PowerPyx via OutputLag — vault escape pairing

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then hit three shops in a row while the stars stay up — if the wanted level fades, the chain breaks and you start over. The trophy can pop about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop, so keep driving until it does.
sources: PowerPyx via OutputLag — chain rule, 30-second pop

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app as you meet them; each new model counts once. 200 of 277 are needed for 100% completion, so keep scanning long after this trophy pops.
sources: PowerPyx via OutputLag — WAiNK scanning, 200 for 100%

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a group of five or more enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the kills before it ends. A mission with a room full of enemies is the reliable place to try it — retry the checkpoint if you fall short.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.target: Fly a plane out of VCIA
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — gates E3 and E4 work — and fly about a kilometre away for the pop. Save first: the airport is heavily guarded and the attempt is easy to fail.
sources: PowerPyx via OutputLag — gates E3/E4, 1 km

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the far south-west island. Get into one — or take one on — and the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the base, so go in with a plan and a fast exit.
sources: PowerPyx via OutputLag — Mile Zero Air Station

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs hands you the Snap Gun for exactly this: use the back door, find the safe-code note, and leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good target if you try it outside the mission.
sources: PowerPyx via OutputLag — Snap Gun, back door, Richardson

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Eight vaults exist; they open through the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, where you tail an armored van. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone — and expect a 4-star wanted level on the escape, which can also earn Hot Together.
sources: PowerPyx via OutputLag — 8 vaults, partner needed

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open, grab the cash and lose the wanted level. Trucks run set routes, so pick a quiet stretch of road and plan your escape before you strike.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The map tracks 52 areas; visit each one and the trophy pops. It pairs with WAiNK It locations and vehicle scanning — explore on foot or by slow driving so the game registers each area as you enter it.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Nine gangs run illegal operations; hit one operation per gang. Operations are marked once discovered, and robbing one also feeds the 100% checklist, which wants 39 of them.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. UNCONFIRMED: the exact trigger has not been pinned down yet — no guide has confirmed which bar, seat or moment pops it. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so try the beachfront bars there, but treat any specific spot as a guess until a source confirms it.
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. UNCONFIRMED: the exact showroom and trigger are not yet confirmed. The description suggests driving a car out through a showroom's glass, in the style of the classic scene — try a vehicle showroom, but do not trust any named location until it is confirmed.
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is the Kolt & Associates alley — an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take the three valuables: the luxury watch, the shotgun and the office safe. If you leave something behind, the operation returns later, so this one is not missable.
sources: PowerPyx via OutputLag — Kingpin Bowling, three valuables

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Get both Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength: buy a gym membership and train with your partner alongside. It is a slow grind, so start training early and keep at it between missions.
sources: PowerPyx via OutputLag — max Strength, gym, partner training

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — the game counts them as you play. Avoid pushing the profile all the way toward Irredeemable, which is permanent. It builds up naturally across a full playthrough.
sources: PowerPyx via OutputLag — 500 actions, Irredeemable warning

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. UNCONFIRMED: the exact trigger is not yet pinned down. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something — retry a failed activity and succeed — but no source has confirmed what counts, so treat every claimed method as unconfirmed.
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? UNCONFIRMED: the exact trigger is not yet pinned down. The description suggests witnessing something strange — the kind of odd event players whisper about — but no guide has confirmed where or when, so do not trust any named location until a source confirms it.
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. UNCONFIRMED: the exact trigger is not yet pinned down. The description suggests knocking people down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, likely near the bowling alley, but no source has confirmed the details — treat any specific method as a guess.
sources: Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in the game

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; pass them to your contacts to launder them. The total accumulates across the whole game, so keep laundering instead of spending marked cash directly.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every shop purchase counts — clothes, food, ammo, cars. It builds up naturally over a full playthrough; if you are close at the end, buy an expensive vehicle or weapon to cross the line.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Eight garages are for sale through the Vice City Real Estate app, after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, for about $160,000 in total. The four garages the story gives you do not count.
sources: PowerPyx via OutputLag — 8 garages, $160,000, Daily Driver

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app opens from the Chapter 2 mission Moses: steal a car, take it to Moses, get a Respray, then Register it. You need a free garage space for each registered vehicle, so buy garages first if you are full.
sources: PowerPyx via OutputLag — Moses, Respray, Register
